title: Foreign Exchange Intervention with UIP and CIP Deviations
title_zh: UIP与CIP偏离下的外汇干预
title_primary: UIP与CIP偏离下的外汇干预
title_secondary: Foreign Exchange Intervention with UIP and CIP Deviations
authors: Philippe Bacchetta, Kenza Benhima, Brendan Berthold
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine the welfare-based opportunity cost of foreign exchange (FX) intervention when both CIP and UIP deviations are present. We consider a small open economy that receives international capital flows through constrained international financial intermediaries. Deviations from CIP come from limited arbitrage or through a convenience yield, while UIP deviations are also affected by global risk. We show that the sign of CIP and UIP deviations may differ for safe haven countries. We find that FX reserves may provide a net benefit, rather than a cost, when international intermediaries value the safe-haven properties of a currency more than domestic households. We show that this has been the case for the Swiss franc and the Japanese Yen. We examine the optimal policy of a constrained central bank planner in this context.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了在同时存在CIP和UIP偏离的情况下，外汇干预的福利基础机会成本。我们考虑一个通过受约束的国际金融中介机构接收国际资本流动的小型开放经济体。CIP偏离源于有限套利或便利收益，而UIP偏离还受到全球风险的影响。

title: Parental Beliefs, Engagement, and Time Investments in Preschoolers
title_zh: 家长信念、参与及对学龄前儿童的时间投入
title_primary: 家长信念、参与及对学龄前儿童的时间投入
title_secondary: Parental Beliefs, Engagement, and Time Investments in Preschoolers
authors: Margherita Fort, Maria Bigoni, Stefania Bortolotti, Roberto Caputo, Annalisa Guarini 等
official: 官方在线 2026-03-03 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper presents a novel app-based survey designed to elicit beliefs about the impact of parental time investments from parents of preschoolers that allows to differentiate the intrinsic value of the activity from the significance of parental engagement. The resulting parental belief indicators exhibit strong internal validity and consistency and correlate with engagement and the quality of daily parent-child interactions, as measured by 24-hour parental time diaries: a one standard-deviation increase in beliefs regarding the importance of engagement is associated with an additional 5 hours spent with the child, 6 hours of engaged time (about 30% in time-use standard deviations).
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一项基于应用程序的新型调查，旨在从学龄前儿童家长中获取关于父母时间投入影响的信念，从而能够区分活动的内在价值与父母参与的重要性。由此得出的父母信念指标表现出较强的内部效度和一致性，并与通过24小时父母时间日记测量的参与度及日常亲子互动质量相关：父母对参与重要性的信念每增加一个标准差，与孩子相处的时间将增加5小时，其中投入时间增加6小时（约占时间使用标准差的30%）。

title: Equal treatment and its market design implications
title_zh: 平等待遇及其市场设计含义
title_primary: 平等待遇及其市场设计含义
title_secondary: Equal treatment and its market design implications
authors: Kenzo Imamura, Kentaro Tomoeda
official: 官方在线 2026-07-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies a new axiom of choice functions, equal treatment of individuals in an indifference class (ETI), in the context of matching problems. We show that when a choice function satisfies ETI, substitutability, and size monotonicity, any individual for whom equal treatment applies must be either always accepted whenever available or never accepted. The set of admissible choice functions expands substantially when any one of these three axioms is dropped. ETI is also incompatible with 𝑞 -acceptance. We characterize the minimum degree of 𝑞 -acceptance violation under ETI, substitutability, and either size monotonicity or consistency. Under size monotonicity, the minimum is characterized by a partition of indifference classes into two groups. By contrast, under consistency, it is characterized by the size of a particular indifference class.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了选择函数的一个新公理——无差异类中个体平等待遇（ETI），并将其置于匹配问题的背景下。我们证明，当选择函数满足ETI、可替代性和规模单调性时，任何适用平等待遇的个体，要么在可用时总被接受，要么永不被接受。若这三条公理中任意一条被舍弃，可容许选择函数的集合将大幅扩展。ETI还与𝑞-接受性不相容。我们刻画了在ETI、可替代性以及规模单调性或一致性条件下，𝑞-接受性违反的最小程度。在规模单调性下，最小值由无差异类划分为两组来表征；相比之下，在一致性下，则通过特定无差异类的大小来表征。

title: On Differentiated Carbon Prices and Discount Rates
title_zh: 差异化碳价格与贴现率研究
title_primary: 差异化碳价格与贴现率研究
title_secondary: On Differentiated Carbon Prices and Discount Rates
authors: David Anthoff, Francis Dennig, Johannes Emmerling
official: 官方在线 2026-07-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The consensus view among economists is that carbon prices, in order to be efficient, must be the same across the globe. But when there are inefficiencies in the allocation of capital so that countries are subject to different discount rates, we show that efficient carbon prices must be different across countries. This is a consequence of Hotelling’s familiar argument on the price of a non-renewable resource: it must grow at the rate of the next best use of marginal funds, which is equal to the country’s discount rate. If different countries discount at different rates, their carbon prices ought to grow at different rates as well. If they grow at different rates, they can’t be the same all of the time, as first-best carbon prices are. The computational climate policy literature has so far avoided this conclusion by altering time preferences in a country-specific way through time-varying Negishi weights. We show that the use of such weights causes inefficient policy prescriptions and, furthermore, has the particularly undesirable consequence of incorrectly discounting future consumption more in countries with high growth rates. The existence of inefficiencies in the savings process—causing differences in discount rates—is well-known and should be acknowledged head on in climate policy analysis. Doing so results in global mitigation policy with carbon price paths for different countries growing (efficiently) at different rates.
abstract_zh: 经济学家普遍认为，碳价格若要实现效率最优，必须在全球范围内保持一致。然而，当资本配置存在效率损失，导致各国面临不同的贴现率时，我们证明有效的碳价格必须因国而异。这一结论源于霍特林关于不可再生资源价格的经典论证：碳价格必须以边际资金次优用途的增长率上升，而该增长率等于该国的贴现率。若不同国家的贴现率存在差异，其碳价格也应以不同速率增长。由于增长速率不同，碳价格便无法像最优状态那样始终保持一致。现有气候政策计算文献通过引入随时间变化的尼格希权重来调整各国的时间偏好，从而回避了这一结论。我们证明，使用此类权重会导致政策建议缺乏效率，并产生尤为不良的后果——在高增长国家中，未来消费被错误地以更高贴现率折现。储蓄过程中的效率损失（导致贴现率差异）是公认现象，气候政策分析应直面这一问题。如此制定的全球减排政策，将使不同国家的碳价格路径以（有效的）不同速率增长。

title: Key equipment and technology imports and firm productivity
title_zh: 关键设备与技术进口与企业生产率
title_primary: 关键设备与技术进口与企业生产率
title_secondary: Key equipment and technology imports and firm productivity
authors: Lingduo Jiang, Shuting Liu, Guofeng Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We exploit China’s 2007 policy promoting the import of key equipment and technology as an exogenous shock and examine its effects on firms’ total factor productivity (TFP). Drawing on a merged dataset combining the Chinese Annual Survey of Industrial Firms and patent filings for the 2003–2009 period, we implement a difference-in-differences strategy to quantify the policy’s impact. We find that the policy led to a statistically and economically significant 1.11% increase in treated firms’ TFP relative to untreated firms during the sample period, and this result remains highly robust across a wide range of empirical checks. A mechanism analysis reveals that the policy primarily relaxes firms’ financial constraints and strengthen their capacity for innovation, especially technological innovation. These mechanistic channels contribute to an observed improvement in productivity. Moreover, the heterogeneity analysis indicates that the productivity effects of the policy are greater among medium and large-sized firms, state-owned and foreign firms, non-superstar firms and firms in financially underdeveloped regions.
abstract_zh: 本文以中国2007年促进关键设备与技术进口的政策作为外生冲击，考察其对企业全要素生产率（TFP）的影响。基于2003-2009年中国工业企业年度调查与专利数据的合并数据集，我们采用双重差分策略量化该政策的影响。研究发现，在样本期内，该政策使受处理企业的全要素生产率相较于未受处理企业显著提升1.11%，这一结果在经济意义和统计意义上均显著，并在多种稳健性检验中保持高度稳健。机制分析表明，该政策主要通过缓解企业融资约束、增强企业创新能力（尤其是技术创新能力）发挥作用，这些机制渠道最终促进了生产率的提升。异质性分析进一步显示，该政策对中型和大型企业、国有及外资企业、非明星企业以及金融欠发达地区企业的生产率提升效应更为显著。

title: The Dynamics of Evasion: The Price Cap on Russian Oil Exports and the Amassing of the Shadow Fleet
title_zh: 逃避的动态：俄罗斯石油出口价格上限与影子舰队扩张
title_primary: 逃避的动态：俄罗斯石油出口价格上限与影子舰队扩张
title_secondary: The Dynamics of Evasion: The Price Cap on Russian Oil Exports and the Amassing of the Shadow Fleet
authors: Cardoso, Diego S., Salant, Stephen W., Daubanes, Julien
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: To reduce Russia’s funding for its Ukraine invasion, Western governments imposed, after a delay, a price ceiling on Russian seaborne oil exports utilizing Western services. To evade that ceiling, Russia developed a “shadow fleet” using no such services. We simulate a calibrated model driven by this fleet’s expansion to assess various sanctions. Mainly, sanctions—from a price ceiling to its extreme service ban version—significantly reduce the present value of Russia’s profits. However, tighter price caps will not necessarily harm Russia if they raise the world price. Shortening the delay between sanctions announcement and implementation can harm Russia more.
abstract_zh: 为削减俄罗斯对乌克兰战争的资金支持，西方政府经延迟后对依赖西方服务的俄罗斯海运石油出口实施价格上限。为规避该上限，俄罗斯组建了不使用此类服务的"影子船队"。我们通过校准模型模拟该船队扩张情景，评估各类制裁措施的效果。主要发现：从价格上限到其极端版本的服务禁令，各类制裁均显著降低俄罗斯利润现值。然而，若更严格的价格上限推高全球油价，则未必对俄罗斯造成损害。缩短制裁宣布与实施之间的延迟期，可对俄罗斯造成更大打击。

title: Prices and Monetary Policy: The Role of Financial Constraints
title_zh: 价格与货币政策：金融约束的作用
title_primary: 价格与货币政策：金融约束的作用
title_secondary: Prices and Monetary Policy: The Role of Financial Constraints
authors: Michael Bauer, Alexander Czarnota, Mathias Klein
official: 官方在线 2026-07-14 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Firm heterogeneity in financial constraints is a quantitatively important driver of how monetary policy transmits to inflation. Using detailed microdata on Swedish public and private firms, and high-frequency monetary policy surprises around Riksbank announcements, we document that smaller, financially constrained firms adjust prices significantly less than larger firms in response to changes in monetary policy. This heterogeneous price response materially dampens the aggregate PPI inflation response to monetary policy. Models of customer markets and financial frictions can explain our findings: because the external finance premium rises after a monetary contraction, constrained firms cut prices less to preserve cash flows, sacrificing future market share. Additional evidence on heterogeneous sales, debt, marginal cost, and markup responses further supports this channel. We consider several alternative explanations, including differences in price adjustments, working capital, market share, and export share, but these cannot explain our main heterogeneity result.
abstract_zh: 企业融资约束的异质性在货币政策向通胀传导过程中具有重要的定量意义。基于瑞典上市与非上市企业的微观数据，结合瑞典央行公告前后高频货币政策意外冲击，我们发现：相较于大型企业，规模较小且面临融资约束的企业在应对货币政策变化时，其价格调整幅度显著更低。这种异质性价格响应实质上削弱了货币政策对总体生产者价格指数（PPI）通胀的影响。客户市场模型与金融摩擦理论可解释这一发现：由于货币紧缩后外部融资溢价上升，受约束企业为维持现金流而减少降价幅度，从而牺牲未来市场份额。关于销售额、债务、边际成本及加成率异质性的额外证据进一步支持该传导渠道。我们考察了包括价格调整成本、营运资本、市场份额及出口份额在内的多种替代性解释，但这些因素均无法解释核心异质性结论。

title: On the approximability of the yolk by the LP yolk in the spatial model of voting
title_zh: 空间投票模型中蛋黄由线性规划蛋黄逼近的可近似性
title_primary: 空间投票模型中蛋黄由线性规划蛋黄逼近的可近似性
title_secondary: On the approximability of the yolk by the LP yolk in the spatial model of voting
authors: Ran Hu, James P. Bailey
official: 官方在线 2026-07-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In the spatial model of voting, the yolk and LP (linear programming) yolk are important solution concepts for predicting outcomes for a committee of voters. McKelvey and Tovey showed that the LP yolk provides a lower bound approximation for the size of the yolk and there has been considerable debate on whether the LP yolk is a good approximation of the yolk. The problem was partially resolved for arbitrarily large committees (as the number of voters goes to infinity) but remains open when there are few voters, which is standard for most committees. In this paper, we show that for an odd number of voters in a two-dimensional space, the yolk radius is at most twice the size of the LP yolk radius and we show that this bound is tight—there exists a family of instances where the LP yolk radius will differ from the yolk radius by a factor arbitrarily close to 2. We also show that (1) even in this setting, the LP yolk center can be arbitrarily far away from the yolk center (relative to the radius of the yolk) and (2) for all other settings (an even number of voters or in dimension k \ge 3), the LP yolk can be arbitrarily small relative to the yolk. Thus, in general, the LP yolk can be an arbitrarily poor approximation of the yolk.
abstract_zh: 在空间投票模型中，蛋黄（yolk）与线性规划蛋黄（LP yolk）是预测委员会投票结果的重要解概念。McKelvey与Tovey证明线性规划蛋黄为蛋黄规模提供了下界近似，但关于线性规划蛋黄能否有效近似蛋黄的问题一直存在激烈争论。该问题在委员会规模趋于无穷大时已得到部分解决，但在标准委员会常见的少量投票者情形下仍悬而未决。本文证明：在二维空间中奇数投票者情形下，蛋黄半径至多为线性规划蛋黄半径的两倍，且该上界是紧的——存在实例族使得线性规划蛋黄半径与蛋黄半径的比值可任意趋近于2。我们同时证明：（1）即便在此设定下，线性规划蛋黄中心与蛋黄中心的距离（相对于蛋黄半径）可任意大；（2）在其他所有设定中（偶数投票者或维度k≥3），线性规划蛋黄相对于蛋黄可任意小。因此，一般而言，线性规划蛋黄对蛋黄的近似效果可能极差。

title: When GDP Misleads: Inferring Living Standards from the Value of a Statistical Life
title_zh: 当GDP误导：从统计生命价值推断生活水平
title_primary: 当GDP误导：从统计生命价值推断生活水平
title_secondary: When GDP Misleads: Inferring Living Standards from the Value of a Statistical Life
authors: Philip Trammell, Charles I. Jones
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Real GDP per person is a widely used proxy for living standards, but it can be a poor welfare measure when new goods or quality improvements matter, when nonmarket goods are significant, and when preferences are nonhomothetic --- all of which are true in practice. We propose an alternative that is robust to these concerns: under weak conditions, the growth rate of the value of a statistical life (VSL), together with standard Euler-equation objects, identifies the growth rate of lifetime utility. The intuition is that people routinely trade off consumption against mortality risk, and their willingness to pay for small risk reductions reveals the value of remaining lifetime utility. Implementing this approach for the United States suggests that lifetime utility may have risen by more than a factor of five since 1940, whereas conventional consumption-based calculations using a stable log/CRRA flow utility imply much smaller gains, on the order of a doubling. This calculation is sensitive to measures of the growth rate of the VSL, the rate of time preference, and the interest rate. For example, if the correct interest rate is 4 percentage points higher than the T-bill rate, then lifetime utility would be measured to have declined by more than half since 1940.
abstract_zh: 人均实际GDP是衡量生活水平的常用指标，但当新商品或质量改进至关重要、非市场商品具有显著影响、且偏好非位似时（这些情况在实践中普遍存在），该指标可能成为糟糕的福利度量。我们提出一种对这些担忧具有稳健性的替代方案：在弱条件下，统计生命价值（VSL）的增长率与标准欧拉方程变量共同识别终身效用的增长率。其直觉在于，人们通常会在消费与死亡风险之间进行权衡，而其为微小风险降低所支付的意愿揭示了剩余终身效用的价值。将该方法应用于美国的数据表明，自1940年以来，终身效用可能增长了五倍以上，而基于稳定对数/CRRA流动效用的传统消费计算仅显示约两倍的增长。这一计算对VSL增长率、时间偏好率和利率的度量高度敏感。例如，若实际利率比国库券利率高4个百分点，则自1940年以来终身效用将被测算为下降超过一半。

title: Addressing weak links in government implementation at scale: Experimental evidence from a school governance reform in Tanzania
title_zh: 大规模政府执行中的薄弱环节：坦桑尼亚学校治理改革的实验证据
title_primary: 大规模政府执行中的薄弱环节：坦桑尼亚学校治理改革的实验证据
title_secondary: Addressing weak links in government implementation at scale: Experimental evidence from a school governance reform in Tanzania
authors: Jacobus Cilliers, James Habyarimana
official: 来源期次 2026-06-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper demonstrates how low-cost innovations can improve the implementation of costly government programs. We experimentally evaluate the nationwide roll-out of a new school governance program in Tanzania. As part of the program, school inspectors conduct Whole School Visits (WSVs) producing a set of school-specific ratings and recommendations—targeted at leadership, teachers, and parents—for improving school quality. However, schools faced weak incentives to implement the recommendations, and the local monitors responsible for conducting follow-up visits, who report to a different ministry, lacked direct access to WSV reports. To address this challenge, in a randomly sampled subset of program schools, monitors received text messages informing them of the main recommendations and encouraging them to follow up with schools to ensure compliance. Within the sample of schools that received WSVs, text messages improved student learning by 0.11 standard deviations after two years. Treatment effects are larger for schools that received worse inspection ratings in each domain, consistent with monitors acting on tailored rather than generic recommendations. Observed gains are concentrated in regions exposed to a donor program that provided local bureaucrats with resources to monitor. Our findings show how addressing specific bottlenecks in implementation can significantly enhance the effectiveness of government programs at scale.
abstract_zh: 本文展示了低成本创新如何改善昂贵政府项目的实施效果。我们通过实验评估了坦桑尼亚一项新的学校治理项目在全国范围内的推广情况。作为项目的一部分，学校督学进行全校访问（WSVs），生成一套针对学校领导、教师和家长的具体评级与建议，旨在提升学校质量。然而，学校在落实这些建议方面面临薄弱激励，而负责后续访问的地方监督员（隶属于另一个部门）无法直接获取WSV报告。为应对这一挑战，在随机抽样的部分项目学校中，监督员收到了短信，告知主要建议并鼓励其跟进学校以确保合规。在接受WSV的学校样本中，短信干预在两年后将学生学业成绩提高了0.11个标准差。处理效应在各项评级较差的学校中更为显著，这与监督员依据定制化而非通用建议采取行动相一致。观察到的收益集中在受捐助项目影响的地区，该项目为地方官僚提供了监督资源。我们的研究结果表明，解决实施过程中的特定瓶颈可以显著提升政府项目在大规模推广中的有效性。

title: HANK-Based Fiscal Consolidation for a High-Debt Advanced Euro Area Economy
title_zh: 基于HANK的高负债欧元区发达经济体财政整固
title_primary: 基于HANK的高负债欧元区发达经济体财政整固
title_secondary: HANK-Based Fiscal Consolidation for a High-Debt Advanced Euro Area Economy
authors: Mr. Gee Hee Hong & Naowar Mohiuddin & Rasmané Ouedraogo & Danila Smirnov & Maryam Vaziri
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: High-debt euro area economies face fiscal consolidation in a low-growth environment. We use a Heterogeneous Agent New Keynesian model to assess how consolidation composition shapes aggregate and distributional outcomes in a representative high-debt economy. The status quo is not neutral: delay generates its own costs through lower investment, higher debt service, and damage to constrained households. For a given fiscal effort, expenditure-based consolidation achieves faster debt reduction with lower growth and distributional costs than revenue-based consolidation. As a complementary exercise, pairing the expenditurebased path with growth-enhancing structural reforms further improves outcomes by lifting real wages, a channel that disproportionately benefits hand-to-mouth households. Across both strategies, modest well targeted transfers to low-income households can substantially mitigate distributional costs at minimal fiscal expense while supporting aggregate demand.
abstract_zh: 高负债欧元区经济体在低增长环境中面临财政整固挑战。我们采用异质性主体新凯恩斯模型，评估不同整固方案对典型高负债经济体的总量与分配效应。现状并非中性：延迟整固将通过抑制投资、增加偿债负担及损害受约束家庭产生额外成本。在既定财政努力下，相较于收入端整固，支出端整固能以更低的经济增长与分配成本实现更快的债务削减。作为补充方案，将支出端路径与促进增长的结构性改革相结合，可通过提升实际工资进一步改善经济表现——这一渠道对月光族家庭的惠及程度尤为显著。两种策略中，针对低收入家庭的适度定向转移支付能以最小财政代价显著缓解分配成本，同时支撑总需求。

title: Logrolling and the power of single-mindedness
title_zh: 单议题偏好与互投赞成票的力量
title_primary: 单议题偏好与互投赞成票的力量
title_secondary: Logrolling and the power of single-mindedness
authors: Arseniy Samsonov, Albert Solé Ollé, Dimitrios Xefteris
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 官方在线 August 202 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study a committee that decides on multiple issues and determines, for each, both the direction and the extent of reform, assuming that reform intensity is proportional to net support and that agents are ex ante symmetric. Within this environment, we investigate how logrolling shapes policy outcomes. We establish three main results. First, an essentially unique competitive equilibrium always exists. Second, logrolling improves the welfare of every committee member, and actually implements the Nash bargaining solution. Third, when the number of issues is sufficiently large, a single-minded delegate fully determines policy within her domain of interest. That is, the current analysis: (i) identifies a setting in which vote-trading may lead to stable outcomes, (ii) uncovers a link between a familiar political practice and a prominent welfare benchmark, and (iii) pins down one mechanism through which single-issue minorities may acquire disproportionate influence in representative democracies.

title: The effect of dating markets on maternal and neonatal health
title_zh: 婚恋市场对孕产妇及新生儿健康的影响
title_primary: 婚恋市场对孕产妇及新生儿健康的影响
title_secondary: The effect of dating markets on maternal and neonatal health
authors: Krzysztof Zaremba
official: 官方在线 August 202 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper provides causal evidence that the sex composition of dating markets affects maternal and neonatal health. Using a novel instrument that leverages randomness in sex at birth to vary the availability of male partners, I find that a more favorable dating market for women decreases non-marital but increases marital fertility, lowers rates of chlamydia and hypertension among mothers, and decreases the incidence of low APGAR scores and a composite index of adverse birth outcomes. These effects appear to operate primarily through changes in relationship dynamics and selection into motherhood. Connecting this to inequalities, racial disparities in partner availability can explain 5–10% of the Black–White pregnancy health gap.

title: Ban Glyphosate—Does It Affect the Swedish Farmers' Willingness to Grow Cover Crops?
title_zh: 禁用草甘膦——是否影响瑞典农民种植覆盖作物的意愿？
title_primary: 禁用草甘膦——是否影响瑞典农民种植覆盖作物的意愿？
title_secondary: Ban Glyphosate—Does It Affect the Swedish Farmers' Willingness to Grow Cover Crops?
authors: Vivian Wei Huang, Anna Kristina Edenbrandt, Elin Röös
official: 官方在线 2026-04-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The cultivation of cover crops is one of the new Eco‐scheme practices introduced in Sweden. This study examines how the design of policy attributes of these schemes influences farmers' willingness to grow cover crops on arable land, with particular focus on the potential impact of a glyphosate ban. A discrete choice experiment was conducted with Swedish crop farmers ( N = 875), considering three policy attributes (commitment duration, maximum allowable percentage of mixed legume plants, and subsidy payment levels), two alternatives (permission to sell or utilize cover crop biomass versus restrictions), and one treatment condition (glyphosate ban). A Latent Class Logit Model was employed to explore heterogeneity in farmers' willingness to grow cover crops. The analysis identified three distinct farmer groups: 29% are unlikely to grow cover crops regardless of policy attribute design, 41% are predisposed to adoption irrespective of policy attributes, and 30% are influenced by subsidy payment scheme design. For the latter group, a glyphosate ban should reduce their willingness to grow cover crops. These findings offer valuable insights for enhancing flexibility in Eco‐scheme management prescriptions for promoting greater farmer participation, such as easing the restriction on the maximum number of legume plants in cover crops and permitting farmers to sell or utilize cover crops.
abstract_zh: 覆盖作物的种植是瑞典引入的新生态计划实践之一。本研究探讨了这些计划政策属性的设计如何影响农民在耕地上种植覆盖作物的意愿，特别关注草甘膦禁令的潜在影响。我们与瑞典农作物种植者（N=875）进行了一项离散选择实验，考虑了三个政策属性（承诺期限、混合豆科植物最大允许比例及补贴支付水平）、两个备选方案（允许出售或利用覆盖作物生物质与限制措施）以及一个处理条件（草甘膦禁令）。采用潜在类别Logit模型来探究农民种植覆盖作物意愿的异质性。分析识别出三个不同的农民群体：29%的农民无论政策属性设计如何都不太可能种植覆盖作物，41%的农民无论政策属性如何都倾向于采纳，而30%的农民则受补贴支付方案设计的影响。对于后者群体，草甘膦禁令应会降低他们种植覆盖作物的意愿。这些发现为增强生态计划管理规定的灵活性以促进更多农民参与提供了宝贵见解，例如放宽覆盖作物中豆科植物最大数量的限制，并允许农民出售或利用覆盖作物。

title: The impacts of global warming on forestry: an age-structured Ricardian approach
title_zh: 全球变暖对林业的影响：基于年龄结构的李嘉图方法
title_primary: 全球变暖对林业的影响：基于年龄结构的李嘉图方法
title_secondary: The impacts of global warming on forestry: an age-structured Ricardian approach
authors: François Bareille, Philippe Delacote, Abdoul Latif Sokoundou
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study extends the Ricardian framework to forestry by accounting for tree growth and harvest dynamics. Indeed, whereas standard Ricardian applications in agriculture assume that farmland prices reflect a perpetual flow of annual profits from the most climate-adapted crops, forestland prices additionally capitalize the age-dependent value of standing timber accumulated over decades. Coupling the Ricardian and Faustmann approaches, we theoretically show that this age dependence is systematically tied to species (and therefore to climate), so that stand age becomes a confounding factor in standard pooled Ricardian regressions. Our theory implies a correction – the age-structured Ricardian approach – that regresses the climate-value relationship across stand-age classes, with the coefficients obtained for the youngest class providing the closest approximation to the true Ricardian effects in the context of forestry. Using geolocated plot-level data from all forestland transactions in France between 2014 and 2023 (over 100,000 plots) matched to forest age at sale (1–219 years), we empirically confirm that standard pooled Ricardian estimates are biased, typically understating the benefits of warmer climates to forestry – in our case, by nearly a factor of two. Consistent with our theory, age-structured coefficients exhibit an inverted U-shape with stand age: capitalization of climate productive effects into forestland prices first strengthens as stands mature and then weakens as slow-growing species increasingly dominate older age classes. Our findings hold under multiple sensitivity analyses and extensions, making clear that ignoring age-related dynamics systematically biases climate estimates in Ricardian applications to forestry.
abstract_zh: 本研究将李嘉图框架拓展至林业领域，通过纳入树木生长与采伐动态来实现。确实，在农业的标准李嘉图应用中，假定农田价格反映的是最适应气候作物所带来的永续年利润流，而林地价格则额外资本化了数十年间累积的立木年龄依赖价值。结合李嘉图与福斯特曼方法，我们从理论上证明，这种年龄依赖性系统地与树种（进而与气候）相关联，使得林分年龄成为标准混合李嘉图回归中的混淆因素。我们的理论提出了一种修正方法——年龄分层李嘉图方法——该方法在不同林分年龄等级间回归气候-价值关系，其中以最幼龄等级获得的系数最接近林业背景下真实李嘉图效应的近似值。利用2014年至2023年间法国所有林地交易的地理定位地块级数据（超过10万块地块），并将其与销售时的林龄（1至219年）相匹配，我们实证确认，标准混合李嘉图估计存在偏差，通常低估了较暖气候对林业的益处——在本案例中，低估幅度接近两倍。与我们的理论一致，年龄分层系数随林分年龄呈倒U型形态：气候生产效应向林地价格的资本化首先随林分成熟而增强，随后因生长缓慢的树种在较老龄等级中日益占优而减弱。我们的发现在多项敏感性分析和扩展检验中保持稳健，明确表明忽视年龄相关动态会系统性地使林业李嘉图应用中的气候估计产生偏差。
